verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows CockroachDB changefeeds with at-least-once delivery guarantees (cockroachdb-docs-5), but no citation explicitly confirms webhook sinks or a webhook subscription mechanism as part of the changefeed feature; older community comments even note the lack of a 'change notification' mechanism. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of webhook sink configuration, webhook payload/auth setup, and any hands-on confirmation of webhook delivery.
